run_findings.github_mcp_effective_capability: GitHub MCP Server read-only/exclude precedence changes effective tools; lockdown is not authorization. Classic PAT scope filtering can hide tools, while fine-grained PAT/GitHub App/server tokens show tools and rely on API enforcement; scope-fetch failure degrades to no filtering. Tool visibility does not prove authorization across auth modes.
